description: The image is a false-colour infrared satellite photograph depicting an airport facility and its surrounding land cover. A prominent long, dark blue/grey runway is visible, with associated lighter blue/white buildings and impervious surfaces located primarily on its eastern side. The number "1240" is overlaid in light blue text on the runway, identifying this feature as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 1240 (Airports). The area immediately surrounding the airport shows a mosaic of land cover types: dense vegetation, likely forests or healthy agricultural fields, appears in bright red, while other areas of sparse vegetation or cultivated land are rendered in lighter green and brown hues. A small, dark blue water body is visible in the upper left quadrant.
